content.study:
Occupier's liability concerns the duty owed by a person sufficiently in control of premises to lawful visitors and, in appropriate cases, trespassers.\
\
Wheat v Lacon established that occupation is a question of control rather than title. Modern analysis uses reasonable care in light of visitor status, premises and foreseeable risk, supplemented by any statutory duties.
